_source: Argentina's Secretariat of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries (MAGyP), report 'Márgenes y Resultados', June 2026, Southeast Buenos Aires region (p. 10). https://www.magyp.gob.ar/sitio/areas/analisis_economico/margenes/
freight_in_marketing_source: CATAC reference freight, ~120 km Balcarce to Quequén (provisional)
_price_point_note: MAGyP prices are Bolsa de Cereales quotes at Rosario or Bahía Blanca port for the harvest month (MAGyP, 'Metodología para el Cálculo y Resultados Agrícolas', June 2025, p. 3), and its 'gastos de comercialización y cosecha' include the trip to that port. The report does not break that item down (checked June 2026 report and the June 2025 methodologies), so the freight inside it is the region's CATAC reference freight, provisional until read in the CATAC table.
